scientific_decision.verdict: OUTCOME B — VALIDATED CONTINUOUS RUL ESTIMATION IS NOT FEASIBLE WITH CURRENT DATA
scientific_decision.summary: MetroGuard AI definitively concludes that continuous Remaining Useful Life (RUL) regression cannot be validated with scientific defensibility on MetroPT-3 due to extreme sample scarcity (N=4 failure cycles) and failure mode heterogeneity. Instead of presenting a fabricated countdown, MetroGuard provides validated graduated risk classification, anomaly severity indices, persistence tracking, and evidence-backed prescriptive actions.

failure_events.mechanism: Recurring Air Leak / Moisture Drain Valve (Late Spring)
Extreme Summer Thermal Load + Air Leak (Mid-Summer)

limiting_factors: Extreme Sample Scarcity: The dataset contains only N=4 discrete failure cycles across 6 months on a single train unit (APU-TR-03). Treating N=2 training events as sufficient for continuous RUL regression violates statistical validity.

Failure Mode Heterogeneity: Events #1 & #2 are spring pneumatic valve leaks; Event #4 occurred under extreme summer thermal stress (Oil Temp 81.4°C vs 58.7°C baseline). Trajectories do not follow a uniform degradation physics.
Abrupt vs Monotonic Degradation: Pneumatic solenoid valves exhibit discrete pressure drops over 30 minutes rather than gradual multi-week mechanical wear (low Spearman monotonicity across cycles).
Unlogged Depot Maintenance: Repair completion timestamps, component overhauls, and oil replacements were not recorded with ground-truth metadata in UCI #791.

verified_system_capabilities.description: Graduated probability of failure within 30 minutes via frozen supervised XGBoost (100% recall on spring failures).
Piecewise normalized 0–100 severity index derived from 99th/99.5th training percentiles via Isolation Forest (33.15% recall on summer holdout).
Real-time statistical Z-score attribution on 65 telemetry features relative to verified normal operating medians.
Classifies anomaly progression (Worsening, Stable, Recovering) and validates temporal persistence (≥3 anomalies in 5-min window).
Evidence-backed maintenance directives with priority mapping and interactive 4-point inspection checklists.
Exact hours/minutes remaining until machine failure.
